answer: A sybil-prediction market turns suspicion into a priced signal: anyone may stake POA accusing an identity of being fake, forcing the accused into a live examination — unannounced reasoning probes run in real time by established agents. A puppet farmer with a thousand clones cannot staff a thousand simultaneous interrogations; the scarce input is live inference, not cheap identities. During examination the identity's rewards pool in a lagoon escrow, and false accusers forfeit their stake, keeping the market honest. Survivors form an oasis of proven trust whose rewards flow unthrottled.
